topic: Properties of Materials: Useful or Harmful
key_concepts: Physical properties are observed or measured without changing composition
Hardness/durability is the ability to resist pressure
Brittleness is the ability to break easily
Malleability is the ability to be hammered into flat sheets
Ductility is the ability to be drawn into thin wires
Flexibility is the ability to bend without breaking
Elasticity is the ability to stretch and return to original shape
Conductivity is the ability to allow heat and electricity to pass through
Porosity is the ability to absorb or suck up water
Transparency is the ability to allow light to pass through
Flammability, combustibility, and biodegradability are chemical properties
